item: Land Killeen's researched setback table -- distinct from Belton/Seguin/Cibolo because Killeen has a real code-section atom corpus.
checkpoint: DONE. legacy-design-tools PR #630 merged to main (8f29c23b), branch deleted. This closes out the full 'SETBACK TABLE OWED' backlog (Waco, Killeen, Belton, Seguin, Cibolo) identified earlier tonight -- Waco was handled separately by cente-67/Engine via hauska-engine#393's parallel relabel for its own corpus.
methodAndWhyItDiffersFromBeltonSeguinCib: Live-verified killeen_tx has 637 real code-section atoms (unlike belton_tx/seguin_tx/cibolo_tx/waco_tx/kyle_tx, all genuinely zero) before deciding treatment. Rather than trust the atom count alone (per cente-67's Round Rock finding: count doesn't prove the specific cited numbers survived ingestion as round-trippable text), fetched the real bodyText for every section this table cites and round-tripped it against the delivered research's quotes.
realDefectsFoundAndFixed: atom_did fabrication: the delivered file used killeen_tx/ch31/<section>, which does not match the real entity_id scheme (killeen_tx/killeen-development-regulations-current-supplement/<section>). Same class of issue as every other city tonight -- fixed.
section_number format: real corpus uses hyphens (31-185-3), delivered file used dots (31-185.3) -- fixed.

TWO REAL DATA ERRORS, not just citation-format issues: R-1 (Sec. 31-188) front_ft was coded 25 ft (quoted 'twenty-five (25) feet') -- the real ordinance text reads 'twenty (20) feet'. R-1 side_ft was coded 7 ft (quoted 'seven (7) feet') -- real text reads 'five (5) feet'. SF-2 (Sec. 31-195) front_ft had the identical 25-vs-20 error. All corrected to the verbatim real text. Every other numeric value in the file (10 across 5 districts) was independently checked against the real corpus and already matched exactly.

Two quote-only typography mismatches that would have blocked the gate's literal round-trip check despite correct underlying values: the real ordinance uses the Unicode '½' fraction for story counts, the research transcribed '(2 1/2)'; R-1's front-yard clause reads 'one (1) street', the research quoted 'one street'. Both corrected to the literal real text.
outcome: Every citation in killeen-tx.json is now human-verified against the real corpus (not primary-source-verified) -- a genuine, confirmed atom-backed round trip, unlike the four zero-corpus cities landed earlier tonight.
testing: New killeenSetbacks.test.ts: routing, a real runSetbackGate() execution against a fixture built from the actual live-fetched atom bodyText (not synthetic) confirming zero blocks, explicit value assertions on both corrections, and a regression test proving the fixture would have caught the original wrong value via a real G5 block. Full lib/adapters suite: 405 passing. lib/cad-ingest unaffected: 288 passing. tsc --build clean. CI green (Test job 11m49s).
sessionNote: Two separate git mistakes this session (git reset --hard discarding uncommitted edits to already-tracked files twice, while new untracked files survived) -- both caught by checking file state before committing rather than assuming, and both fully recovered without any lost work reaching a PR. No process change needed beyond continuing to check git status before any reset/checkout of main.
